invocation_script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
test "$(id -u)" -ne 0
export PATH=$VERIFY_ROOT/bin:/opt/lean-audit/lean-4.34.0-rc2-linux/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/$(id -u)
export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/bus
cd $VERIFY_ROOT/project
test ! -f .lake/build/lib/lean/NavierStokes/ComparatorSolution.olean
python3 - > ../logs/preflight.json <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
p = Path.cwd()
def git(*args, cwd=p):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=cwd, text=True).strip()
expected = 'f9e8bc5b38b6e212696e8a30e3e91517af887bbd'
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == expected
assert git('status', '--porcelain=v1') == ''
manifest = json.loads((p / 'lake-manifest.json').read_text())
deps = []
for package in manifest['packages']:
    root = p / '.lake/packages' / package['name']
    actual = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD', cwd=root)
    status = git('status', '--porcelain=v1', cwd=root)
    assert actual == package['rev'], (package['name'], actual)
    assert not status, (package['name'], status)
    deps.append({'name':package['name'], 'commit':actual, 'clean':True})
config = json.loads((p / 'ComparatorChallenges/NavierStokes.json').read_text())
assert config['enable_nanoda'] is True
assert config['permitted_axioms'] == ['propext', 'Quot.sound', 'Classical.choice']
assert config['theorem_names'] == ['NavierStokes.Comparator.navier_stokes_breakdown_R3', 'NavierStokes.Comparator.navier_stokes_breakdown_periodic']
files = ['lean-toolchain', 'lakefile.toml', 'lake-manifest.json', 'ComparatorChallenges/NavierStokes.lean', 'ComparatorChallenges/NavierStokes.json', 'NavierStokes/ComparatorSolution.lean']
source_files = [{'path':f, 'git_blob':git('rev-parse', 'HEAD:' + f), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in files]
print(json.dumps({'commit':expected,'clean':True,'uid':os.getuid(),'dependencies':deps,'config':config,'source_files':source_files,'solution_precompiled':False,'resource_wrapper':'Only sets LEAN_NUM_THREADS=8 and execs the unchanged pinned lake binary.'},indent=2))
PY
date -u -Iseconds > ../logs/comparator.started
set +e
systemd-run --user --wait --pipe --collect --unit=ns-proof-comparator --property=RestrictAddressFamilies=~AF_UNIX -E PATH="$PATH" -E COMPARATOR_LANDRUN=$VERIFY_ROOT/bin/landrun -E COMPARATOR_LEAN4EXPORT=$VERIFY_ROOT/project/.lake/packages/lean4export/.lake/build/bin/lean4export -E COMPARATOR_NANODA=$VERIFY_ROOT/nanoda_lib/target/release/nanoda_bin --working-directory="$PWD" -- $VERIFY_ROOT/bin/lake env .lake/packages/Comparator/.lake/build/bin/comparator ComparatorChallenges/NavierStokes.json
comparator_exit=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$comparator_exit" > ../logs/comparator.exit
date -u -Iseconds > ../logs/comparator.finished
git status --porcelain=v1 > ../logs/post-source-status.txt
exit "$comparator_exit"
